summary: AAP 2.6 upgrades all 2.4 components except EDA. A mixed setup with EDA 2.6 connected to a 2.4 cluster is possible, where 2.4 has only controller and hub and 2.6 has EDA and the unified UI; mixing install methods is unsupported. Production EDA 2.4 users should contact Red Hat.
questions: Can EDA 2.6 connect to an AAP 2.4 cluster?
Can I mix RPM and containerized installs in one AAP topology?
What should I do if I run EDA 2.4 in production?
